<!-- pr-reviewer: 3aec1f223432a61f8aa7225e2caad0c385440e4c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- Diffed against the shipped files: `tormach-770m-plus.mch` and `tormach-1100m-plus.mch` differ from their M files only in the model name and the three axis speeds. Those speeds (300/300/250 and 300/300/230) are byte-identical to the 770MX and 1100MX axis lines. Travels, spindle, belts and power are the M's.
- `rigid_tapping` is false on both. The tap test refuses it by name on both machines.
- The Tormach quote is recorded in `docs/decisions/618-tormach-m-plus.md`, with the considered-and-dropped list, so the provenance is clean-room safe. No new dependencies, build.rs, scripts or .github changes.
- `MACHINES` and the `machine.rs` expectations are both updated. The new `an_m_plus_is_its_m_with_the_mx_axis_speeds` compares the M+ against the shipped M and MX files rather than copied numbers. The two SPECS rows are added too.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #618`, and CHANGELOG.md is untouched.

Local results (merged with fresh upstream/main, clean merge)
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| tormach_machines | 6 passed |
| machine | 32 passed |
| machine_library | 11 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -D warnings | clean |

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/app/tests/tormach_machines.rs`, just above the new `// #618` comment: `},    // #618: ...` has a stray run of spaces after the brace. Put the comment on its own line.
- The M+ figures rest on Tormach's relayed word, not a manual of the M+'s own. The decision file says so.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
